about_the_game:
About the Game
Step into a dazzling futuristic world filled with neon lights, advanced technology, and mysterious sci-fi landscapes. Your mission: find over 100 mischievous cats hidden throughout beautifully hand-drawn futuristic environments. From bustling cybercities to serene space stations, explore every corner to uncover these playful felines.

Relax and unleash your creativity by coloring black-and-white scenes with guided palettes or freeform painting using soft pastel tones. The special “Meow FM” radio station provides calming lo-fi and chillhop music to accompany your journey.

Play solo to challenge yourself or team up with friends in online co-op mode for double the fun. Compete on solo leaderboards and celebrate your discoveries together!

Dive into a vibrant, imaginative future filled with fun, creativity, and plenty of purring surprises! 🐾🎨
